phase1a_classical_baseline.note: classical query-search baseline per (tier, r); q=0 bug fixed (section 2 of REPORT.md)

oct8.note: per-size A/B/C + global depolarizing fit, with chi-square and f_ci95_inflated (sqrt(reduced_chi_square)) added this pass

run1.note: chi-square + f_ci_inflated added this pass (was missing before)

run4.note: chi-square + f_ci_inflated added this pass (was missing before)

phase1b_fits.goodness_of_fit: reduced chi-square is 15-250 across all fits (far above 1); the model is phenomenological -- it captures the trend and the peak-r shift, not an exact fit within shot noise. Use f_ci*_inflated, not the raw bootstrap CI, for any CI quoted in the manuscript.

phase1d_tvd_hellinger.note: per (tier, r): TVD and Hellinger distance, hardware vs ideal and hardware vs FakeMarrakesh noisy simulator, plus a TVD null-floor/p-value

phase1e_digital_twin.note: calibration-day digital twin (gate_error + readout_error only, no thermal relaxation -- device BackendProperties has no frequency field) vs generic FakeMarrakesh, TVD per cell

h1.conclusion: the gate-count increase alone predicts a drop of 0.01865, which is LARGER in magnitude than the observed difference of 0.01432 -- the gate-count change can account for the entire observed H1 difference at n=3; H1 at n=3 is confounded and provides no clean evidence of day-to-day drift

gate_matched_alternative.cell: ladder_n4_M2_r2 (n=4, r=2) -- identical two-qubit gate count both runs (113=113)
gate_matched_alternative.note: supplementary evidence, outside H1's preregistered n=3-only scope, but the only gate-matched (unconfounded) drift comparison available

h1.source: computed in analysis/manuscript_numbers.py from cpc_run1_fit.json, cpc_runs_analysis.json, results/cpc_revision/run3_layout_comparison.json

h2.verdict: NOT SUPPORTED -- r=1 significant in the opposite direction (DD off beats DD on)

effective_error_ratio.note: effective error per two-qubit gate (1-f) is roughly 2.7-3.4x the calibrated two-qubit error on the qubits actually used, across two devices and two dates -- an observation with only 3 points, not a law
effective_error_ratio.source: phase1b_global_fit.json, cpc_run1_fit.json, cpc_run4_fit.json (f, inflated CI), historical_calibration.json + run1_run4_median_2q_error.json (median two-qubit error)
